method: HTTP byte-range reads of 8-byte Parquet tails and footer metadata only; pyarrow.parquet.read_metadata on synthetic header+footer. No full Parquet or CSV download.
license_note: Catalog license grants free use/copy with full notice retained and DOE/NREL/ALLIANCE credit. OEDI links a CC badge; do not assume exact CC license without resolving discrepancy.
verified_field_notes: Actual Parquet weather names use outdoor_air_*, while the catalog/README says outside_air_*.
Official air-temperature unit is degrees Fahrenheit; convert Celsius=(F-32)*5/9.
cooling_kw includes outdoor cooling fans, pipe trace heaters, and dedicated tower filter pump.
The tower filter pump constant is 2.67 kW; cooling_kw already includes it, pump_kw excludes it. Do not add it again without a measured reconciliation.
hvac_kw is separate electrical-room fan walls/fan coils and make-up air unit; cooling_kw is not total cooling-system electrical power.
No independent total-facility-power column, water supply/return temperature, flow, valve position, or fault labels appears in the schemas.
quality_flags_requiring_full_data_audit: Weather timestamp minimum is 1970-01-01; it must not be interpreted as valid historical coverage.
Both timestamps are timezone-naive; UTC cannot be assumed from metadata.
Negative power values and extreme PUE values are present in footer ranges; investigate provenance and physically plausible screening before modelling.
Minimum IT power near zero can destabilise PUE; PUE and its components are algebraically coupled.
Full data timestamp uniqueness, sample interval, gaps, duration weighting, alignment, valid date window and usable sample count remain unverified.
No claim of regular 5-minute or 1-minute sampling is supported by the checked metadata.
Dataset spans major operational years; hardware/control changes may exist and require regime assessment.
proposal_target_boundary: Provisional main target cooling_kw only. Pump and HVAC power may be supplemental outcomes; do not sum components before meter-boundary reconciliation.
site_transferability: ESIF is a warm-water liquid-cooled HPC facility with heat recovery, thermosyphon and evaporative towers in a semi-arid climate. Do not claim direct generalisation to Hong Kong/Singapore chiller-based commercial IDC operation.
